entries.reason: Authored coordinate prototype with coronal 11-joint topology, bilateral carries, and stepping.

frames.caption: Stand tall between the weights with the feet balanced.
The weight shifts and one heel peels off the floor.
Push off with short, quiet steps; the weights stay beside the hips.
Step through while the weights stay quiet at the sides.
Plant the midfoot under the hips with the shoulders packed.
The opposite foot pushes off the same way.
Short, controlled steps; the posture stays tall.
The heel peels as the stride finishes, core braced.
The cadence cycle completes and the next step begins.

entries.name: Suitcase Carry
entries.summary: Five drawn positions of a one-sided carry, seen from the front.
entries.instructions: Stand beside one dumbbell or kettlebell and take a secure grip with the feet balanced beneath you. Stand tall with both shoulders level and the loaded arm long beside the hip. Walk a straight line with controlled steps; if the shoulder drops or the path curves, reduce the load.
entries.cues: Keep both shoulders level. Walk a straight line. Keep the weight quiet beside the hip.
entries.coachingIntent: Train one-sided carrying without letting the load tilt or rotate the torso.
entries.reason: Authored over Farmer Carry's drawn frames, shared by reference: the gait is the base's own, and the difference is ONE bell in the near hand (implementCount 1) with the far hand empty. Draft preview pending qualified technique review.

captionOverrides.carry-1: Stand tall beside one bell: feet balanced, chest up, shoulders level.
captionOverrides.carry-2: The load hangs quiet as one heel peels off the floor. Walk as straight as you can.
captionOverrides.carry-3: Push off with short, quiet steps and stay as straight as you can; the loaded shoulder stays level.
captionOverrides.carry-4: Step through without letting the load tilt the torso.
captionOverrides.carry-5: Plant the midfoot under the hips with the loaded side packed.
captionOverrides.carry-6: The opposite foot pushes off the same way.
captionOverrides.carry-7: Short, controlled steps along a straight line.
captionOverrides.carry-8: The heel peels as the stride finishes, core braced against the tilt.
captionOverrides.carry-9: The cadence cycles and the next step begins.
